text:
meera: quick q — i'm rolling out per-model feature flags via ConfigMap under models namespace. i opened a PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2345.

meera: main concerns: 1) secrets wiring for per-model keys (mount as env or use ExternalSecret?), 2) is checksum-annotation on deployment ok for triggering rollouts during flag flips? snippet of current config i'm testing:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: model-configs
data:
  model-a.json: |
    {
      "flags": {
        "use_new_embed": false,
        "soft_ban": []
      },
      "runtime_knobs": {
        "max_cache_ttl": 1200
      }
    }
```

sam: +1 on using ExternalSecrets rather than committing secrets. keep flags in ConfigMap, secrets in k8s secrets synced by external-secrets operator. mount secrets as env or use projected volume if you need file paths.

sam: for checksum, we use the annotation approach. example we use elsewhere:
```yaml
annotations:
  checksum/config: "{{ include (sha256sum .Files.Get \"model-a.json\") }}"
```
that triggers rollout when config changes. works fine for canary too.

aj: fyi — if you plan to store full per-model configs in the ConfigMap, watch size limits (1MB per obj). for large model metadata blobs, prefer object storage (s3) + small flags in CM.

aj: also consider storing per-model small overrides as a single merged json to avoid N configmap objects per model. smaller surface for rollouts.

meera: good call on size — i'll split: keep just flags/runtime knobs in CM, push large metadata to s3 and fetch at init. will add ExternalSecret to sync model keys into namespace as k8s secret and mount via envFrom.

john: don't forget RBAC — the service account that reads ExternalSecret needs permissions. ping @security for quick review.

meera: plan for rollout: canary 10% (one replica), monitor errors + perf for 1h, then promote. i'll add the checksum annotation and a canary K8s Deployment (label traffic via our router).

infra-bot: deploy pipeline started for pr/2345 to staging — apply succeeded. :white_check_mark:

sam: one more nit: add a feature-flag default false in code path so mis-rollouts are safe.

meera: will add that and an integration test that flips the flag in staging. thanks all :pray:

meera: I'll update the PR with ExternalSecret manifest, RBAC, and split the config. assigning follow-ups: @sam for ExternalSecret pattern, @aj for config size strategy, @john for RBAC review.
